title: Amazon CloudWatch

fields.name: add_entity
fields.description: Add entity to PutLogEvent calls.

fields.name: alias
fields.description: Sets an alias, use for multiple instances of the same output plugin.

fields.name: auto_create_group
fields.description: Automatically create the log group.

fields.name: auto_retry_requests
fields.description: Immediately retry failed requests to AWS services once.

fields.name: endpoint
fields.description: Specify a custom endpoint for the CloudWatch Logs API.

fields.name: external_id
fields.description: Specify an external ID for the STS API, can be used with the role_arn parameter if your role requires an external ID.

fields.name: extra_user_agent
fields.description: This option appends a string to the default user agent.

fields.name: log_format
fields.description: An optional parameter that can be used to tell CloudWatch the format of the data.

fields.name: log_group_class
fields.description: Specifies the log storage class for new log groups when auto_create_group is set to true.

fields.name: log_group_name
fields.description: The name of the CloudWatch log group that you want log records sent to.

fields.name: log_group_template
fields.description: Template for CW Log Group name using record accessor syntax.

fields.name: log_key
fields.description: By default, the whole log record will be sent to CloudWatch.

fields.name: log_level
fields.description: Specifies the log level for output plugin.

fields.name: log_retention_days
fields.description: If set to a number greater than zero, and newly create log group's retention policy is set to this many days.

fields.name: log_stream_name
fields.description: The name of the CloudWatch log stream that you want log records sent to.

fields.name: log_stream_prefix
fields.description: Prefix for the log stream name.

fields.name: log_stream_template
fields.description: Template for CloudWatch Log Stream name using record accessor syntax.

fields.name: log_suppress_interval
fields.description: Suppresses log messages from output plugin that appear similar within a specified time interval.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Set a tag pattern to match records that output should process.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Set a regular expression to match tags for output routing.

fields.name: metric_dimensions
fields.description: Metric dimensions is a list of lists.

fields.name: metric_namespace
fields.description: An optional string representing the CloudWatch namespace for the metrics.

fields.name: profile
fields.description: Option to specify an AWS Profile for credentials.

fields.name: region
fields.description: The AWS region to send logs to.

fields.name: retry_limit
fields.description: Set retry limit for output plugin when delivery fails.

fields.name: role_arn
fields.description: ARN of an IAM role to assume for cross account access.

fields.name: sts_endpoint
fields.description: Specify a custom STS endpoint for the AWS STS API.

fields.name: tls.windows.certstore_name
fields.description: Sets the certificate store name on an output (Windows).

fields.name: tls.windows.use_enterprise_store
fields.description: Sets whether using enterprise certificate store or not on an output (Windows).

fields.name: workers
fields.description: The number of [workers](/manual/4.2/administration/multithreading.md#outputs) to perform flush operations for this output.

description: Fluent Bit output plugin: Amazon CloudWatch.
